description: Land Acquisition - Galahela, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 415/57 dated 20.08.1986 - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2208/28 dated 31.12.2020 - Correction paper to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2239/67 dated 07.08.2021
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific plots of land being acquired by the government, including descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, claimants' information, and boundary details. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its land-related nature.
